notes:
- Direct Discord login: Connect with official Discord web login inside the app or paste your token directly, with on-device verification and no relay server.
- Relay removed: Rich Presence now publishes straight to Discord from your device for simpler setup and faster, more reliable updates.
- More control: New activity type, online status, custom activity name, button labels/URL, elapsed-time toggle, and smoother network update options.
- UI and loading polish: Revamped Discord settings with clearer status, animated/live preview states, cleaner layout, and faster initial loading.
- Fixes and stability: Improved joke rotation, publish/connect race handling, preview behavior, and connection flows for a steadier Rich Presence experience.
